SELECT 
  fish_date_doy, 
  fish_date_season,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 2) as avg_per_angler
FROM trips
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, fish_date_season, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_season DESC, fish_date_doy DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  fish_date_season,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as num_trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 2) as catch_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE yt > 0
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, fish_date_season, cls
ORDER BY total_yt DESC
LIMIT 40

SELECT DISTINCT
  fish_date_doy,
  fish_date_season,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as num_boats
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy <= 30
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, fish_date_season, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Analyze seasonal patterns across all seasons
trips = tables['trips']
pier = tables['pier']

# Group by day of year and calculate average yellowtail per angler by doy
seasonal_pattern = trips.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': ['sum', 'count'],
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
seasonal_pattern.columns = ['doy', 'total_yt', 'num_boats', 'total_anglers']
seasonal_pattern['catch_per_angler'] = seasonal_pattern['total_yt'] / seasonal_pattern['total_anglers'].clip(lower=1)
seasonal_pattern = seasonal_pattern[seasonal_pattern['total_yt'] > 0].sort_values('catch_per_angler', ascending=False)

print("Top 20 days of year for yellowtail catch per angler:")
print(seasonal_pattern.head(20)[['doy', 'catch_per_angler', 'num_boats', 'total_yt']])

print("\n\nCatch rate by day of year (quarterly view):")
for q in [1, 2, 3, 4]:
    start = (q-1) * 91 + 1
    end = q * 91
    q_data = seasonal_pattern[(seasonal_pattern['doy'] >= start) & (seasonal_pattern['doy'] <= end)]
    print(f"Q{q} (doy {start}-{end}): avg {q_data['catch_per_angler'].mean():.2f}, peak {q_data['catch_per_angler'].max():.2f}")

# Check water temperature by day of year
pier_data = tables['pier']

# Get daily average water temperature
daily_temps = pier_data.groupby('ts_doy')['wtmp_c'].mean().reset_index()
daily_temps['wtmp_f'] = (daily_temps['wtmp_c'] * 9/5) + 32
daily_temps = daily_temps.sort_values('ts_doy')

# Focus on seasonal pattern
print("Water temperature by day of year:")
for doy in [1, 95, 105, 115, 138, 172, 225, 270, 288, 295, 301, 350]:
    temp_f = daily_temps[daily_temps['ts_doy'] == doy]['wtmp_f'].values
    if len(temp_f) > 0:
        print(f"doy {doy}: {temp_f[0]:.1f}°F")

print("\nTemperature range by quarter:")
for q in [1, 2, 3, 4]:
    start = (q-1) * 91 + 1
    end = q * 91
    q_temps = daily_temps[(daily_temps['ts_doy'] >= start) & (daily_temps['ts_doy'] <= end)]['wtmp_f']
    print(f"Q{q}: {q_temps.min():.1f}°F - {q_temps.max():.1f}°F, mean {q_temps.mean():.1f}°F")

# Analyze performance by trip class
trips = tables['trips']

class_performance = trips[trips['yt'] > 0].groupby('cls').agg({
    'yt': ['sum', 'count', 'mean'],
    'anglers': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
class_performance.columns = ['cls', 'total_yt', 'num_boats', 'avg_yt_per_boat', 'avg_anglers']
class_performance['catch_per_angler'] = trips[trips['yt'] > 0].groupby('cls').apply(
    lambda x: x['yt'].sum() / x['anglers'].sum()
).reset_index()[0].values

class_performance = class_performance.sort_values('catch_per_angler', ascending=False)

print("Performance by trip class (only days with yellowtail):")
print(class_performance)

# Also check by cost efficiency
pricing = {
    'hd_am': 80,
    'hd_pm': 80,
    'three_quarter': 150,
    'full_day': 275,
    'hd_twilight': 80,
    'overnight': 400,
    'day_1_5': 550,
    'multi_day': 800  # approximate
}

print("\n\nExpected value by class (catch per $ spent on productive days):")
for cls in class_performance['cls'].values:
    cpa = class_performance[class_performance['cls'] == cls]['catch_per_angler'].values[0]
    cost = pricing.get(cls, 0)
    if cost > 0:
        ev_per_dollar = cpa / cost
        print(f"{cls:15s}: ${cost:3.0f} -> {cpa:.3f} yt/angler -> ${ev_per_dollar:.4f} yt/dollar")
